settings.headline: A system, not a single product.
settings.subhead: Senseless is a UK cosmetic product, built for the procedures aesthetic clinics actually run. Three strengths and three formats, formulated to match what each appointment asks of the skin. The system is the answer.
settings.image_alt: Editorial Senseless product system still life, multiple SKUs

settings.headline: A UK cosmetic product. Built for aesthetics.
settings.body: Senseless sits in the cosmetic product category. Not a medicine. Not a pharmacy product. A topical preparation formulated specifically for the way modern aesthetic appointments run — short windows between booking and the chair, sensitive treatment areas, and clients who care about the experience as much as the result. The category matters because it shapes what the product is built for and how it's regulated.
settings.image_alt: Editorial close-up of a Senseless topical preparation, the UK cosmetic category

settings.headline: Three strengths. Three formats. One framework.
settings.body: The Senseless system has two axes — strength and format. Strength matches the procedure: Clinical for routine appointments, Advanced for longer or more sensitive sessions, Professional — our practitioner tier — for the longest, most sustained sessions. Format matches the treatment area and the session length: cream for most face appointments, gel for sustained sessions, spray for body and broader zones. Together they answer two separate questions, not one.
settings.image_alt: Editorial Senseless system view — all formats and tiers

settings.headline: A short routine ahead of your appointment.
settings.body: Senseless is applied before your appointment, at home or wherever you're preparing. Clean the treatment area, apply a thin layer, leave it for the time your practitioner recommends, wipe before the procedure starts. Specific timing varies by procedure, by tier, and by clinic — your practitioner is the best guide for the appointment you've actually booked.
settings.image_alt: Editorial Senseless product-in-use shot, no faces

settings.headline: What the product is built to support.
settings.body: Senseless is a topical preparation that supports comfort during your aesthetic appointment. Specific experience varies between clients — sensitivity, treatment area, procedure type, practitioner protocol. Many find prepared skin more comfortable than unprepared. The product isn't a substitute for a practitioner's care during your booking; it's the preparation step that sits before it.
settings.image_alt: Editorial still life of the Senseless range supporting appointment comfort

settings.heading: Why we don't talk about the active
settings.body: You'll notice this page doesn't lead with the active ingredient. Senseless is a UK cosmetic product, and the formulation details that matter are on the packaging and in the regulatory documentation that sits behind each SKU. What matters at the point of purchase is the system — strength matched to procedure, format matched to treatment area, brand built for aesthetics. The product specifics support that. They don't lead it.
